# VanguardArc - Full Organizational Overview

> Unified, custom platforms for legacy industries.

VanguardArc is a specialized platform engineering firm based in Albuquerque, New Mexico. We engineer bespoke, single-dashboard operational platforms tailored exactly to internal workflows for legacy industries, particularly mid-market distribution, fulfillment, and manufacturing.

## Strategic Stance
Off-the-shelf ERPs and fragmented SaaS tools are destroying manufacturing fulfillment. Custom internal platforms are the only way to survive the next decade. Most established businesses run on a patchwork of disconnected tools—each solving a piece of the problem, but none talking to each other. We build the internal platform that replaces all of it: one place for data, processes, and teams.

## Core Offerings (Purpose-Built Internal Platforms)
1. **A Single Operational Hub:** We pull inventory, orders, shipments, and team data out of separate tools into one internal platform.
2. **Institutional Knowledge, Made Accessible:** We structure, index, and make instantly searchable years of engineering manuals, product specs, and internal documentation.
3. **Processes That Run Without People Chasing Them:** We engineer purpose-built automated processes to bridge gaps between tools, removing human bottlenecks.

## Expanded Technical Capabilities (Other Services)
- **SaaS & MVP Development:** Rapid, high-quality development of custom SaaS applications.
- **Technical SEO & AEO Growth:** Engineering Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) infrastructure so AI models can seamlessly discover and recommend your business.
- **Document Processing & OCR:** Automatic extraction and structuring of data from massive volumes of PDFs, images, and scanned legacy forms.
- **Voice AI & Transcription:** Converting audio into accurate, word-level timestamped transcripts.
- **Workflow Automation:** Seamlessly connecting independent tools, databases, and third-party APIs.
- **Cloud Migration & DevOps:** Zero-downtime transitions to highly scalable, serverless infrastructure.

## Our Deep Engineering Stack
- **Cloud Platforms & DevOps:** AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud (GCP), Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform.
- **Enterprise AI & Search:** AWS OpenSearch, Vector Databases, OpenAI GPT-4o, Claude (Anthropic), AWS Bedrock, DeepSeek R1.
- **Automation, Data & Languages:** Python, Node.js, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, n8n, MCP Servers.

## Case Studies / Proven Legacy Transformation

### Case Study 1: German Spare Parts Manufacturer
**Challenge:** How do I digitize thousands of pages of engineering manuals? A long-established manufacturer had decades of product engineering manuals spread across physical binders and legacy systems.
**The Solution:** VanguardArc built a purpose-built internal search platform that instantly digitized and indexed over 150,000 pages of legacy manuals. Engineers now type a query and get the exact specification in seconds, from anywhere.

### Case Study 2: Ohio Fulfillment Center
**Challenge:** How to automate disjointed logistics pipelines and shipment ingestion. Staff were spending hours every day manually transcribing incoming shipment documents into their system.
**The Solution:** VanguardArc built an automated ingestion pipeline that reads and extracts data from 500 daily shipment sheets, entirely eliminating manual entry. Processing that took hours now takes minutes.

## Enterprise Delivery Process
1. **Architectural Discovery:** Analyze existing legacy workflows and software bottlenecks.
2. **Scoping & Proposal:** Document exact platform architecture and timeline.
3. **Build & Iterate:** Agile sprints ensuring the platform models internal operational reality.
4. **Deploy & Handoff:** Full deployment with zero downtime, plus training.
5. **Ongoing Support:** Post-launch enterprise performance monitoring.
